mcvoice.name: MCvoice
mcvoice.command.auto.on: Auto-read enabled: text sent from the chat box will be spoken automatically.
mcvoice.command.external.on: Switched to the external TTS command.
mcvoice.command.external.set: External TTS command saved and enabled.
mcvoice.command.help: /mcvoice say <text> | /mcvoice stop | /mcvoice test | /mcvoice auto [on|off] | /mcvoice volume <0-200> | /mcvoice distance <1-128> | /mcvoice external [on|off|set <command>] | /mcvoice voice list | /mcvoice voice set <voice> | /mcvoice config
mcvoice.message.no_voice: No speech engine is available yet. Check that a model is installed, or enable external TTS.
mcvoice.message.not_connected: Not connected to Simple Voice Chat yet; audio will only play locally.
config.mcvoice.title: MCvoice Config
config.mcvoice.unsupported: This build supports Windows x64 only. macOS and Linux will not list local voices; use a Windows PC or an external TTS service.
config.mcvoice.general.routeThroughVoice: Play to other players (through the server voice mod)
config.mcvoice.general.autoSpeak: Auto-read text sent from the chat box
config.mcvoice.advanced.tooltip: Open volume, range and external TTS settings.
config.mcvoice.volume.tooltip: Adjust the volume for local playback and SVC playback.
config.mcvoice.distance.tooltip: Centred on your position; the real range is still limited by the SVC server and group settings.
config.mcvoice.external.command.label: External TTS command
config.mcvoice.external.command.tooltip: Enter the full command; {text} is replaced by the text and {file} by the WAV output path.
config.mcvoice.external.command.explain: Example: edge-tts --voice zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural --text "{text}" --write-media "{file}". The command may instead read the MCVOICE_TEXT and MCVOICE_OUT environment variables and write a WAV file.
config.mcvoice.external.service.title: External TTS service
config.mcvoice.external.service.enable.t: When enabled, speech is generated through an HTTP request.
config.mcvoice.external.service.mode.too: Click to switch between URL template, OpenAI-compatible and free TTS.
config.mcvoice.external.service.route.to: Microsoft Edge direct connection retries and falls back to the regional HTTP endpoint; the apizero backup supports voices such as Sichuan Mandarin.
config.mcvoice.external.service.volume.t: Applies to all three modes; in free mode it is sent to the service, in the other modes the returned audio is amplified.
config.mcvoice.external.service.url.tool: Enter the service URL; the URL template accepts {text}, {voice}, {model} and {volume}.
config.mcvoice.external.service.key.hint: Leave empty when no authentication is needed
config.mcvoice.external.service.key.tool: Enter the API key when authentication is required, otherwise leave it empty.
config.mcvoice.external.service.voice.to: Enter the voice name used by the service.
config.mcvoice.external.service.voice.fr: Click to cycle through the voices supported in free mode.
config.mcvoice.external.service.model.hi: for example tts-1; may be left empty
config.mcvoice.external.service.model.to: Fill this in when the service needs a model name.
config.mcvoice.models.open.tooltip: Open the local mcvoice folder to add or inspect models.
config.mcvoice.models.download.tooltip: Download Piper and Sherpa Chinese voices; failures fall back to an alternative source automatically.
config.mcvoice.voice.tooltip: Open the voice list and pick the voice to use.
config.mcvoice.voice.select.title: Select voice
config.mcvoice.voice.empty: No voice is available yet; download a model from "Download Chinese voices" first.
download.mcvoice.source.notice: Note: some models have no reliable download source in mainland China; using an accelerator (for GitHub and similar) is recommended.
download.mcvoice.title: Download Chinese voices
download.mcvoice.unsupported: This build supports Windows x64 only. Model downloads are not available on macOS and Linux.
download.mcvoice.status.ready:
Piper above, Sherpa / Matcha / Kokoro below.
After downloading, go back to the config screen to switch voices; models can also be placed into mcvoice/models by hand.
speech.mcvoice.title: MCvoice Speech
speech.mcvoice.linger.tooltip: When enabled, unsent text is kept even after leaving the speech screen; once a sentence is sent the box is cleared and the screen closes. Off by default.
speech.mcvoice.history.replay: Click to speak this line again.
config.mcvoice.warn.local_only: The mod can only be heard locally; other players cannot hear it
config.mcvoice.warn.pv_needs_server: Plasmo Voice needs MCvoice installed on the server to take effect
config.mcvoice.volume.label: Volume: %s%%
config.mcvoice.distance.label: Range: %s blocks
config.mcvoice.external.service.route.ap: Free route: apizero (Sichuan Mandarin and others)
download.mcvoice.status.resumable: An unfinished model download was found; click its button to continue
download.mcvoice.status.restart_norange: The server no longer has a matching range; restarting download of %s
download.mcvoice.status.restart_noresume: The source does not support resume; restarting download of %s
download.mcvoice.status.failed_resumable: Download failed: %s · partial file kept, click the button to continue
download.mcvoice.error.archive_too_small: The downloaded archive is too small to be a valid model
download.mcvoice.error.verify_failed: The model downloaded but failed validation
download.mcvoice.error.onnx_too_small: The downloaded ONNX file is too small to be a valid model
download.mcvoice.error.config_not_json: The downloaded model config is not valid JSON
download.mcvoice.error.html_not_file: The service returned a web page instead of a model file
download.mcvoice.error.bad_range: The source returned a non-contiguous range
config.mcvoice.en_only_note: Actually this mod is Chinese-only and most download sources are inside mainland China. I only added an English UI to pass review >:(
config.mcvoice.audioout.tooltip: Send a copy of the in-game TTS audio to a chosen output device, e.g. a virtual cable (VB-CABLE). Another app can then pick the matching recording device as its microphone and hear what you type in game.
config.mcvoice.audioout.title: Audio Output
config.mcvoice.audioout.mode.label: Audio output: %s
config.mcvoice.audioout.mode.tooltip:
Click to cycle through the three modes.
In game only: plays as before, only you hear it.
External device only: no speaker output, written to the device selected below (use this when you do not want to hear it yourself).
In game + external device: both at the same time.
config.mcvoice.audioout.volume.label: External device volume: %s%%
config.mcvoice.audioout.volume.tooltip: Affects only the copy sent to the external device. The in-game volume is still controlled by the volume slider one level up. 0%% sends silence.
config.mcvoice.audioout.section: Output device (virtual cables are listed below)
config.mcvoice.audioout.empty: No audio output device was found. Make sure the system has a working playback device, then reopen this screen.
config.mcvoice.audioout.device.select: Click to use this as the output device
config.mcvoice.audioout.device.virtual: Looks like a virtual cable: set another app's microphone to its matching recording side (e.g. CABLE Output) and it works as a mic.
config.mcvoice.audioout.device.physical: This is a normal playback device (speakers/headphones). Picking it just duplicates the sound and other apps cannot capture it.
config.mcvoice.audioout.hint: How to use: install VB-CABLE, pick "CABLE Input" here, then set your microphone in the voice app to "CABLE Output" and you can talk with it while playing. The device list is rescanned every time you open this screen, so just reopen it after plugging something in.
